headlines.title: 49ers vs. Vikings recap: Brock Purdy bolsters MVP case in Mexico City win
headlines.description: Waymo will pause its service in San Francisco starting Monday because of the storms, Mayor Daniel Lurie announced on Sunday. Lurie wrote on a social media post Waymo said it will pause service beginning Monday at 4 a.m. because of the forecasted heavy storms and high tides expected next week. It is unknown when the service will be resumed. The announcement comes a day after the mayor announced SFMTA was suspending parking enforcement starting Monday through Wednesday to help residents “prepare for the storm.” “I know many of you have travel plans for the Thanksgiving holiday. If you can, use Monday to get your errands and holiday travel done—and don’t park vehicles in flood zones,” Lurie wrote on a social media post.
